verdict.rationale: x402's batch-settlement scheme is explicitly designed for bulk agent operations — 'agents perform thousands of granular interactions while maintaining the economic efficiency of a single transaction,' with cryptographic vouchers redeemed together onchain instead of per-call settlement. However this is scoped narrowly to payment settlement batching, not general bulk operations across arbitrary resources, and all evidence is first-party documentation with no independent/hands-on confirmation of bulk throughput in practice. Missing for 10: independent verification of batch-settlement at scale, evidence of bulk operations beyond payments (e.g., bulk resource fetch/discovery), third-party benchmarks.
